final_answer: Of course. I have completed the compliance audit of the repository `https://github.com/Aadisheshudupa/3DTinKer` against the regulations outlined in `sample_regulation.pdf`. Here is a comprehensive report of the findings. ### Audit Summary The automated audit identified a total of **58 violations** within the codebase. The violations fall into three main categories as defined by the regulation: Security, Accessibility, and Credential Management.
